name: seuil
description: Private harm-reduction PWA: encrypted session tracking, substance cards, interaction checker, effect curves, inventory, statistics, and optional AI review. Vanilla JS + Flask.

paragraphs: A private, offline-capable harm-reduction journal. Log your sessions, read educational substance cards, check risky combinations, and keep your data under your own control — encrypted end-to-end.

Seuil is an information, self-tracking and harm-reduction tool. It does not encourage the use of psychoactive substances and never guarantees the safety of a dose, a product or a combination. Its content replaces neither medical advice, nor drug checking, nor the support of a specialised service. An "indicative threshold" or a "low-risk" interaction never means safe.

Seuil ("threshold" in French) is a harm-reduction (réduction des risques) web application aimed at people who want to slow down decisions, document what they take, and understand the risks — privately.
features: Record sessions with date/time, substance, route, dose, unit, set/setting and
Use exact units (mg, g, ug, ml) or configurable qualitative units such
as line, joint, glass, tablet, drop, puff or dose when precision is unavailable.
elapsed time, cumulative dose, live notes, and per-substance redosing.
